visual_action: A cutout image of Donald Trump in golfing attire (a black pullover, black pants, and a white "USA" hat) is animated to make it look like he is dancing against a shifting background. The background starts as plain white, then changes to a yellow sunburst graphic, and finally to a yellow and orange checkerboard pattern.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is the sole person depicted in the video, shown dancing, and is the subject of the on-screen text.

spoken_summary: The audio is a cover of the song "Macarena." A female voice sings lyrics in both English and Spanish, including "Come and find me, my name is Macarena" and "Dale a tu cuerpo alegría, Macarena." The on-screen text displays some of the English lyrics as they are sung.
audio_music: An upbeat, festive pop track that is a cover of the song "Macarena." The song plays continuously throughout the video, creating a jarring and mocking contrast with the negative on-screen text.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous, looped animation of a cutout image dancing. There are no cuts, but the cartoon background changes multiple times.
manipulation_or_satire: A still photograph of Donald Trump has been digitally cut out from its original background and animated to make him appear to be dancing. This is superimposed over cartoon backgrounds for a mocking, satirical effect.
central_claim: Donald Trump is carelessly celebrating after irresponsibly allowing a flesh-eating screwworm into the U.S.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as foolish, irresponsible, and worthy of ridicule by juxtaposing a serious accusation with a celebratory song and dance.
